data.name: Mansoor
data.gender_notes: Mansoor is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ن-ص-ر (n-ṣ-r), 'to help, grant victory'. Manṣūr means 'victorious'. Its root is ن-ص-ر (n-ṣ-r). A common Muslim given name. Mansoor is a Arabic name meaning “Victorious; aided (by God)”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mansoor expresses “Victorious; aided (by God)”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ن-ص-ر (n-ṣ-r), 'to help, grant victory'. Manṣūr means 'victorious'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mansoor total 32, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
